defects.description: production.env overrides CACHE_TTL_SECONDS to 0, silently disabling caching in production while base config and documentation both say 300 seconds.
The override was a leftover debug change, never reverted -- nothing in the config loading or review process flags an environment override that contradicts the base/documented value.

The stale debug value and an intentional, unrelated config change (DB_POOL_SIZE) were committed together with no comment distinguishing them, making the accidental change easy to miss in review -- a process/observability gap, not just a wrong value.
